received excellent feedback from the client regarding the smoothness of this operation.

targets.text: Job Profile: Technical Architect (Dubai Islamic Bank)
Advanced hands-on experience on Genesys Engage based Contact Management Solution design, deployment and
configuration on a global scale.
Comprehensive knowledge in architecting, designing & deploying Omni Channel enabled Contact Centre
Platform leveraging Genesys Engage solution
Technical expertise in the Customer Experience (CX) and Contact Center domains which includes - Contact
Management / Routing systems, Interactive Voice Response Systems, SIP Telephony systems, Outbound and
Proactive servicing, Digital channels, Contact Recording and Analytics platforms.
Hands-on experience with application solution architecture design and end-to-end software development of
complex distributed (multi-tiered) Contact Center solutions.
Experience in creating complex and detailed Solution Artifacts and Design flows that clearly illustrate solution
architecture and design
Knowledge on Cloud Native Design principles ( Microservices ) and Containerization technologies ( Dockers &
Kubernetes )
Roles and Responsibilities:
Be part of the ConneX Platform – Architecture team – assist the team on Discovery and Design tasks.
Evaluating and solutioning new Capabilities & Features
Responsible for setting up and driving architectural design, proof of concepts and new products review
Create Solution Artifacts and design flows that clearly layout the solution architecture and design for Delivery
teams
Job Profile: Manager – Project – (Apple & British Telecom)
Responsible for GWS ,SIP Server and eServices components installation, configuration, upgrade and maintenance for all
Business Unit(AC/RCDx and HL) in IT/UAT and Production environment. Managed the Genesys UAT/IT environment –
Involved in configuration, upgrades, deployments, troubleshooting, fixing issues. Worked closely with the Apple business
teams and development teams to manage downtimes and maintain high availability. Worked in a very dynamic
environment, collaborating with various teams to meet project goals.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting the GWS , TServer/SIP Server, eServices and Genesys environmental issues to provide a
framework level solution.
Prepared the plan for UAT and production installation.
Monitoring the performance of the applications and environment.
Production rollout plan and issue support.
Job profile: Sr. Technical Support Engineer.
Perform 2nd level diagnosis, troubleshooting and resolution of complex customer issues on a range of software products
(eServices,(which includes IXN,UCS,ESJ,Chat,WebAPI, and SIP Server,GWS,WWE and WDE) and subsystems, in order to
ensure customer satisfaction is to the highest possible level at all times.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Attempt to isolate, reproduce and resolve problems using available systems and tools, and investigate potential
workarounds for verified defects.
Maintain the customer incident tracking system (Salesforce) with regular updates and resolution details.
Information to include symptoms, diagnosis, actions and all relevant data.
Participate in the creation of Knowledge Base articles, solutions and other related support collateral.
To be the escalation support interface with customers and partners when necessary and to ensure that the
company is represented in the most positive manner at all times.
To interface with Subject Matter Experts, where the problem cannot be resolved at a frontline support level.
To help set the correct problem resolution expectations and to provide timely progress reports to the
appropriate levels of the support organization.
Participate in a shift and on-call roster as necessary, to provide support coverage outside of standard business
hours.
Perform other related support duties, as required by the company.
Attend training courses to sustain/enhance product knowledge and work in accordance with the policies and
procedures outlined within the quality assurance documentation.
American Airlines/Hosted ICS/IHG/THD
Technology
GENESYS-GVP 8.1 /GENESYS Framework 8.1/ SIP Server/IRD/URS/Reporting/WFM/E-services
ERSC Tier-2 team receives, owns, and resolves issues related to ERSC Supported Client platforms
(AMR/HICS/IHG/THD).
The ERSC Day Two Support Engineer completes this task with the use of monitoring
tools(Vizgems,CBUs alarm etc), process, and teamwork.
Project Abstract
The India team member is responsible for receiving and working tickets according to specified time
frames (SLA).
Responsible for troubleshooting of Genesys components issue and engagement Centennial team,
TAMs, CSMs, vendor and tiered support as needed.
Inbound customer calls will continue to be managed out of the Centennial location.
❑ Proactive monitoring, troubleshooting of Genesys component through Vizgems,SCI/GA.
Role
❑ Troubleshooting of Genesys Call routing issues and Handling the AOTS ticketing tool to lock
the ticket and continues follow-up with respective team towards resolution of the ticket
❑ Perform/Supporting for various maintenance windows scheduled activity on daily basis as
per Change Calendar.
❑ Page out to CTL/CSM if any major issue which impact production system we immediately
communicate with customer to understand the impact and open/ initiate bridge calls with
different department to mitigate the issue and also find the RCA for the same.
❑ Troubleshooting Genesys logs on Windows platform for apps like URS, Routing Stat server
Media server, RM, SIP T-Servers.
❑ Genesys Call Center Reporting, WFM & Infomart DB, CCPulse++.
ICICI
GENESYS-GVP 8.0 /GENESYS Framework 8.0/ SIP Server/
IWS/URS/GIM ETL/Stat
Technology
Server/CCPulse+
ICICI has deployed next generation Voice Self service GVP application in order to access account
information of the customer such as corporate account, Loan& Demat information through IVR
application.
Project Abstract
ICICI customer can access their account related information through IVR and also can get Balance
enquiry information, Cheque Book Renewal, Fund transfer, Check stopping, Last 10 Transaction
through IVR just by entering debit card/CRN number.
Implementing, Trouble shooting and Technical Support of all Genesys Modules version 8.0
and 8.1.
Involved in proactive monitoring, troubleshooting of Genesys application with testing of each
modules.
❑ Generating daily call reports using Infomart DB
Role
❑ Troubleshooting Genesys logs on Windows platform for apps like URS, Routing Stat server
MCP,RM, SIP T-Servers
❑ Genesys Call Center Reporting, WFM, QGM & CCPulse++.
JP Morgan Chase (Retail)
Intervoice- Invision studio ,GVP 7.6,Genesys CTI 7.2 ,Web phone, SQL Server and Monitoring tools.

targets.text: Technology
JPMC Contact Centre is an Multi site Environment which provides customer support for Retail.
Project Abstract
JPMC contact centre integrated of Intervoice - Invision studio (IVR) for automatic voice response &
GENESYS CTI for intelligent Routing.
Customers will call the Toll Free no to access an IVR self service Application to get the various details
about Home loans, Education loans etc., if the customer wants to talk to the agent, the call will be
transferred to the appropriate agent, these call will pop out in the Webphone of the agent desktop.
❑ Monitoring and troubleshooting (in case of any issues) the data network of Genesys, IVR
associated servers and MAPD-AES Interfaces.
❑ Active monitoring, troubleshooting Genesys IVR issues.
❑ Troubleshooting of IVR and Genesys Call routing issues and Handling the Peregrine
ticket(Ticketing system)
❑ Analyzing IVR and Genesys log files to determine Root cause of production issues
Patching and testing the new updates on JPMC Server (MS and UNIX) to ensure no impact on
application and implementation.
Role
Initiating bridge calls with different department to mitigate the issue and also find the RCA for the
same.
Involved in Configuration of all the CME Objects.
❑ Doing Maintenance of Genesys Application Production Servers every Month.
Involved in getting knowledge transfer about the JPMC Contact Centre Environment,
❑ Troubleshooting all the Genesys, IVR & Webphone Production Issue.
Involved in the Analysis in order to minimize the Production Issue.
If any problem occurs raise a Ticket and escalate to the appropriate department.
Involved in raising tickets for the production issues with Intervoice, TBOC, IOC, WINTEL of JPMC
Group.
TTML (Tata Tele Maharashtra Ltd)
Amdale® PowerConnect software/GVP 7.2/Genesys Framework 7.2 /Speech Pearl8.0 /DB2/
Technology
Donjin® JCT 600 CTI boards.
Project Abstract
Customer can access the information about various customer services like prepaid, postpaid and
dealer through Genesys-IVR self service application.
Customer can also retrieve various details on their handset, value added services, product
information through IVR self services just by dialing customer care services.
Installed, Configured and implemented Genesys Framework components.
❑ Developing Genesys Routing Strategies.
Role
❑ Checking the logs and troubleshoot the issue if any CTI link failure.
❑ Creating alarms and log specific events in the Solution control interface.
❑ Troubleshooting the GAD related issue.
❑ Daily Testing the Lab & Production Environments log levels, Active alarms.
Tata Tele Services Ltd (TATA DOCOMO)
Technology
Cisco CVP, ICM, Cisco Voice Gateways, Cisco VXML, PGW. ITP Routers, SQL server
The IVR Self Service solution is intended to enable TTSL to provide enhanced services to their GSM &
CDMA customers all over India.
Project Abstract
This project consists of one Data Centre and five Hub locations. The components and architecture of
this solution contains ITP 2811, PGW 2200, Media Gateway AS5400/AS5350, VXML Gateway AS5350,
CSS 11500, SS7 link, ICM 7.5.
Involving in proactive monitoring and supporting of all Cisco voice gateways.
❑ Understanding the application design and call flow in order to support the application and to
handle any new enhancement
❑ Working with all teams regarding opening and resolving the incidents, RFC and Service request.
Role
❑ Configuring SMS scripts, uploading promotional and floating prompt in the respective VXML
servers.
❑ Generating IVR DoYS reports for various services like prepaid, postpaid, Dealer, in roamer and
privilege callers using SQL browser.
Vodafone
Technology
Avaya IR designer, Avaya IR 1.3, Unix,VXML
The IVR Self Service solution is intended to enable Vodafone to provide enhanced services to their
Vodafone customers all over India.
Project Abstract
RAPCTI is a Servion product which gets all the call related information and provides it to the agents
as a pop up. This gives the agents complete information profile about the customer (such as
customer details and the menu options chosen by the customer on the IVR)
Worked as an On-site Engineer providing support & implementation to Vodafone across India for
Interactive Voice Response (IVR), RAP CTI.
❑ Monitoring the Critical IVRs and all Production Servers and tracking the day to day issues
raised and completing it within TAT and fulfilling the SLA of the Client.
Implementation of Avaya IVR, IP-IVR, configuring DIP, Vonetix, AES Signal Links, creation of
vector programming, skill group, Hunt group in Avaya ACD
❑ Maintenance of AVAYA- IR , and all Production Web Servers
Role
❑ Generating report for all the region’s based on issues, Application etc
❑ Follow-up with the third party vendors for completion of issue related to their
product/Application
❑ Maintenance of RAPCTI Servers:RAPCTI Screen Pop-up Server and Agent Screen Pop-up
application
❑ Guiding and mentoring new support team members
Indian Railways
Technology
Amdale® Power Connect software/Speech pearl/ MS.Access/D41JCT/D4PCI
This application will broadly consist of the following modules divided as per the type of services.
Main Module – Main module generate the essential details like caller id, date and time,
dialedmode, call duration etc for Reports and billing purpose.
PNR- PNR will give the current status of the Ticket.
Arrival and Departure- Arrival and Departure will give the details of the arrival and departure of
Project Abstract
the train.
Accommodation & Fare Enquiry - Accommodation, Fare Enquiry will give the details of the seat
vacancy position and fare details.
Plan your Journey - Plan your Journey will give the details of the trains running between the
source and destination station.
Other Enquiry- Other enquiry will give the other details like Concession Fare, Special Train
info, Facility & Amenities, Rules & Regulations, Historical Info etc.
Involved in implementation and support.
Role
Involved in impatient module and unit testing of the application.
Involved in Environmental setup.
BSNL (Passport)
Technology
Amdale® Power Connect software / Speech Mania 8.0/MS-Sql Server/VB.net.
This project is done for BSNL.
The proposed system is to setup an ASR with IVRS fallback system, in which the users can know
Project Abstract
their status of their passport application. They can also know the procedure for applying the
passport just by speaking or dialing the options.
Involved in Requirement Gathering.
Role
Involved in Design, Development and Testing of the application.
Involved in Environmental setup..
BSNL(1044 Service)
